start.text: Yeshwantpur? Green? This side, that side, everyone is running. I came for my son's wedding shopping and the station ate me.

choices.text: Come, uncle. I'm going the same way.
The green stairs, uncle — over there, top right.

walk.text: God bless. Walk slowly, my knees are from the village, not from the gym.

point.text: Green. Top right. Green. (He repeats it all the way there, a little louder each time.)

walking.text: Still walking, still walking. You young people walk like the train is chasing you.
